modelDescription: Featuring an unyielding commitment to strength, reliability and quality, the Ronin 1911 combines a legacy of service with the features modern shooters demand. Strength is a core element of the Ronin line, with all models offered featuring forged steel slide, hammer-forged barrels and forged frames. It features a beautiful two-tone finish, with a forged carbon steel slide featuring a beautiful hot salt bluing treatment topping off a contrasting forged frame. The rear sight combines high-visibility white dots with a "Tactical Rack" ledge for one-handed cycling of the pistol. The pistol's hybrid smooth/checkered Crossed Cannon wooden grips complement the attractive two-tone finish. The pistol features an enhanced grip safety featuring a beavertail and raised "memory bump" for positive engagement. Streamlined and skeletonized, the Gen 2 Speed Trigger of the Ronin is designed for performance. Includes AOS plate for red dot.

subProducts.description: Springfield, 1911 Ronin, Semi Automatic, 10mm, 5" Barrel, Blued Slide/Stainless Frame, Fiber Optic Sights, AOS Optic Cut, Crossed Cannon Grips, Right Hand, 8 Round Capacity
